*   **Model:** It appears to be a **bullpup-style rifle** (likely an **AUG** or similar model). It features an **integrated raised rail/scope** mounted on top of the receiver.
*   **Position:** The weapon is positioned in the **lower right** portion of the screen, partially obscured by the "BUY" menu overlay.
*   **Colors & Details:** The rifle has a **grey/tan (desert)** color scheme. A **vertical foregrip** is clearly visible on the handguard. You can also see the distinct shape of the magazine inserted behind the grip, characteristic of bullpup designs.
*   **Visibility:** The weapon is **visible** and appears to be **reasonably sized** for a first-person viewmodel. It is **not clipping through the camera**; it sits naturally in the lower-right periphery of the view.
